title: Microsoft, Health-ISAC, Japanese authorities, and more disrupt a Chinese-language phishing kit ecosystem used to send 1B+ messages to 75K+ organizations in 2026 (Matt Kapko/CyberScoop)
summary: Matt Kapko / CyberScoop: Microsoft, Health-ISAC, Japanese authorities, and more disrupt a Chinese-language phishing kit ecosystem used to send 1B+ messages to 75K+ organizations in 2026 — In less than 10 months, cybercriminals used the arsenal of customized, targeted phishing kits to send more than 1 billion malicious messages …
